verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the account-merging doc, which says merging "keeps Poke's Memory" from the selected account. That confirms a persistent Memory feature exists. Nothing describes how memory is captured, recalled, or applied to new conversations. missing for 10: documentation of what Memory stores and how it is applied in new chats, user controls to view/edit/delete memories, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-conversation recall.
